# Welcome to the docs

Everything you need to understand how Jack & Jill works, from getting started to team permissions and ATS integrations.

[Overview\\
**Who is Jill?** \\
What Jill does, the dual-agent model, where candidates come from, and how Jill compares to agencies.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/who-is-jill) [Overview\\
**Getting Started** \\
Sign up, create your first role, and get your first shortlist in under 10 minutes.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/getting-started) [Core Features\\
**Search & Candidate Discovery** \\
How Jill finds and scores candidates, activity indicators, feedback loops, and Public Profiles.\\

The document that drives everything — how Jill builds it, what's in it, and how to edit it.\\

The consent-based intro flow, the candidate pitch, and what candidates actually see.\\

Pipeline stages, shortlisting, passing, candidate notes, and ATS integration.\\

How auto-join and approval-based team membership work.\\

Set up the Jack & Jill BambooHR integration so your candidate pipeline stays in sync.\\

**Pinpoint ATS Integration** \\
Set up the Jack & Jill Pinpoint integration so your candidate pipeline stays in sync.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/pinpoint-ats-integration) [Integrations\\
**Teamtailor ATS Integration** \\
How the Jack & Jill Teamtailor integration receives candidates from your pipeline, imports existing ones, and can add, move and reject candidates with an optional Admin key.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/teamtailor-ats-integration) [Integrations\\
**Greenhouse ATS Integration** \\
Not live, pending partner review. How the Jack & Jill Greenhouse integration will keep your candidate pipeline in sync.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/greenhouse-ats-integration) [Integrations\\
**Lever ATS Integration** \\
How the Jack & Jill Lever integration adds candidates to your job postings, moves them between stages, and archives or hires them.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/lever-ats-integration) [Integrations\\
**Personio ATS Integration** \\
Set up the Jack & Jill Personio integration to submit candidates to your Personio jobs.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/personio-ats-integration) [Integrations\\
**Custom ATS Integration (beta)** \\
Beta. Your team hosts a small API, and Jill keeps your pipeline in sync. The Jack & Jill team turns this on for your account.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/custom-ats-integration) [Integrations\\
**Slack Integration** \\
Connect Jill to Slack, create role channels, and manage Slack notifications.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration) [FAQs\\

Pricing, support, who Jill works for, and common questions about using the platform.\\
Read guide](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/faqs)
